name: neurosignal-titanium-orchestrator
description: Unified root orchestrator for the NeuroSignal Enterprise ecosystem.

scripts.install:all: cd pdd-website/backend/express-server && npm install && cd ../../frontend && npm install
scripts.launch:hub: concurrently "cd pdd-website/backend/express-server && npm start" "cd pdd-website/frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.launch:app: concurrently "cd pdd-app/backend/express-server && npm start" "cd pdd-app/frontend && npm run dev"
